attendance_levels: Two or three times a month
formulas: X = [age basis (4 columns, looked up by integer age), female, educ_secondary, educ_higher, town_small, town_mid, city, metropolis, relig, relig2, ses, ses2] minus centres
relig = (attendance level 1-6 minus relig_centre) / relig_scale; relig2 = relig^2 before centring; ses = ses_z for the chosen quintile; ses2 = ses^2 before centring
age_c = (age - age_mean) / age_sd; big_c = (residence level >= 4) - bigcity_mean
XI = [age_c*educ_secondary, age_c*educ_higher, age_c*relig, big_c*educ_secondary, big_c*educ_higher, female*age_c], with the centred educ, relig and female columns of X
eta_k = coef[k][0] + sum(X * coef[k][1..P]) + sum(XI * coef[k][P+1..P+Q]); probabilities = softmax(0, eta_1..eta_K), first entry is not voting

support.note: Kernel-weighted counts of observed respondents like the person on each pair of characteristics; the calculator uses the smallest of the four.
